sources.locator: Official ASNEF.FIN.DAT; complete transient scan of 9,200,232 fixed-width records; four eligible private identifiers and all exact-name candidates adjudicated; identifiers withheld
sources.collection_name: World War II Army Enlistment Records
sources.rights_notes: No raw row, full private identifier, or other subject's full name is retained. Robert H, Robert E and Robert T Davis have exact identifier-and-name agreement; Minor M Davis has an identifier/full-name conflict. Six- and seven-character index values were not padded. The incomplete Army file is not a comprehensive OSS, officer, Navy, Marine Corps, civilian, women's-service, Coast Guard, or foreign roster; a non-hit is not negative proof.

sources.title: World War II Army Enlistment Records: Code Lists
sources.repository_publisher: National Archives at College Park - Electronic Records
sources.locator: Code No. 30, Civilian Occupations, PDF physical page 171 / printed page XI and physical pages 176-177; entries 0-72 and 3-36, plus neighboring 9-89/absence of 9-99, visually and textually checked
sources.collection_name: World War II Army Enlistment Records technical documentation
sources.rights_notes: The official table defines 0-72 as Retail managers and 3-36 as Farm couples. It shows 9-89 among the miscellaneous occupations but not 9-99, so value 999 is not interpreted. Occupational groups identify neither a named employer, workplace, exact role, nor the sequence from Army service to OSS.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation value 072 was recorded at Army entry on October 23, 1942. NARA's code table defines 0-72 as Retail managers; no employer, workplace, or exact role is identified.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and full name confirm the Army identity. The historical occupational group is not converted into a named employer, immediate-OSS affiliation, workplace, or exact management role.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation value 336 was recorded at Army entry on April 5, 1943. NARA's code table defines 3-36 as Farm couples; no spouse, farm, employer, workplace, or exact role is identified.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and full name confirm the Army identity. The historical occupational group is preserved without inferring a spouse, farm, employer, immediate-OSS affiliation, workplace, or exact role.

claims.claim_text: Minor M Davis has an unresolved private-identifier/full-name conflict.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier printed in the OSS index selects an Army entry whose name contains additional initials; no exact-name Army row resolves the difference.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier and full-name evidence conflict; the Army record is not assigned to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The identifier-selected Army row is dated July 8, 1942, but none of its service, occupation, or biographical fields is accepted for Minor M Davis.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier and other subject's full name remain private. Box 171 and the original Army record require review.

claims.claim_text: The OSS index and Army merged file identify the same Robert H Davis.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier and exact full name agree across the two official NARA records.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private-identifier and full-name agreement.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army row records entry on October 23, 1942, as private.
claims.match_notes: The private value is withheld publicly. Eighty other exact-name Army rows carry different identifiers and remain unassigned.

claims.claim_text: Robert H Davis's Army-entry record classifies the prior civilian occupation under retail managers.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-matched Army row carries value 072; NARA's official code list defines 0-72 as retail managers.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed exact private-identifier and full-name match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded at Army entry on October 23, 1942; no employer, workplace, or exact management role is identified.
claims.match_notes: The historical occupational group is not converted into a named employer, immediate-OSS affiliation, workplace, or exact job title.
